title: Conversational AI That Holds Up
subtitle: Dialog logic, guardrails and evaluation, and an AI assistant a service team chose to use

bio.short: I design and build conversational AI that holds up with real people: dialog logic, guardrails set in code, and tests against labeled cases. At Bibel TV I built a Microsoft Copilot assistant for viewer services and introduced it myself. By the team's account it's now part of their regular work.
bio.long:
At Bibel TV I built a Microsoft Copilot assistant that drafts replies to viewer letters, emails and social messages in the support handbook's wording. A person reads every message and makes every send decision. I introduced it myself as an optional tool, with a self-test week and one-to-one sessions. As the team reported it, complex letters took minutes instead of hours, and part-time staff answered in the house voice from the start. Both early skeptics use it.

Aperto is a spiritual guide app in development. I designed its dialog and guardrails so that code decides what may happen and the model only how it's phrased. A safety classifier can only raise the level, helplines come from a verified list, and the assistant asks at most one clarifying question. I also built a voice mode with spoken input and reply. Against labeled sets, the safety layer caught 102 of 102 crisis messages and 147 of 147 passive signals. Designed and directed; implemented with AI coding agents.

I also created an n8n pipeline with AI agents that turns sermon videos into Bible-verse-tagged clips: 11,405 from 3,504 videos by October 2026. I'm a product designer who ships production code. I like building a new capability from the start, with the people who will use it.

context.company: BavariaDirekt is the direct insurer of the Versicherungskammer group. Its Operations unit is building a new capability around conversational AI and AI agents on a conversational-AI platform.
context.role: A hands-on AI Designer seat. It designs, configures and develops AI voice agents on the platform and tests them systematically. It works with business units, IT and external implementation partners.
context.emphasis: Lead with guarded dialog design and systematic evaluation, then the production assistant a service team adopted. Mechanisms, not subject matter. Name the built voice mode once, plainly, as built.
